summary: Split out of MPI-567. Four flow-frame bugs Fabio found on the first live look at Scribble to Object, all in code EVERY flow shares: inputs never persisted outside _run, spacebar advancing a step via native button activation on the focused nav arrow, no arrow-key navigation, and MpiColorPicker emitting a bare ui:close-all-popups that takes the whole Flow overlay down. Root causes traced to the line in plan.md - do not re-derive. Runs in PARALLEL with MPI-567, which owns the flow registries and the scribble workflow; this card owns MpiBaseFlow and MpiColorPicker.

Fifth bug folded in from MPI-567: promptRequired is declared on fifteen-odd ops in commandRegistry.js, its JSDoc calls a prompt mandatory, and NOTHING in js/ reads it. That is why an empty-prompt run of Scribble to Object was never stopped - the frame guard at MpiBaseFlow ~2029 aborts only when there is neither media nor a prompt, so a photo with no words runs. Same dead-declaration family as inputSchema.positive, which sat inert in the scribble FlowDef and read as a wired prompt to a whole session. The fix is frame code, so it was handed here rather than reached across the claim boundary.

Sixth item added from MPI-567, non-blocking but same file: a field id declared on a GIZMO step AND on the run slide silently drops edits from the second run onward. Gizmo steps key fields by role in _stepValues[role].fields while flow fields live in _fieldValues, and _collectInputs applies the flow store last; after one run the flow-level copy seeds from s_flowInputs at the payload root and overwrites what the user typed on the step. A kind:fields step does NOT have this problem because it is a FRAME kind with no role and seeds into the flow store by design, which is why character-sheet declaring its prompt twice works and reads as precedent. Either unify the stores for a shared id or make the collision loud. MPI-567 wants its prompt on both surfaces and cannot have it until this lands.
